QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_54

question.text: Kalpataru Fund has committed capital INR 50 crore, fund tenure 3 years, NAV at end of Year 3 = INR 70 crore, hurdle 10% p.a., incentive fee 20% on total profits, NO CATCH-UP clause. Amount distributed to the MANAGER:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ex 9.4 (no catch-up): Total profit = 70 − 50 = 20 cr. Hurdle amount = 50 × (1.1^3 − 1) = 50 × 0.331 = 16.55 cr. Residual profit after hurdle = 20 − 16.55 = 3.45 cr. Without catch-up, Manager gets 20% × 3.45 = INR 0.69 crore. The Trap: Option A uses 20% of total profit (ignores hurdle). Option B is the ENTIRE residual (ignores 80/20 split). Option D is just the hurdle amount. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A tests no-catch-up from sell side; this is Ex 9.4 of NISM workbook. Manager's Pro-Tip: This mirrors Ex 9.4. Take note: without catch-up, even after beating hurdle by INR 3.45 cr, the GP earns only INR 0.69 cr — 'catch-up' dramatically changes GP economics. Negotiation hinges on this.
